data.narrative:
Lumotive is a Series B semiconductor company that has raised $72M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 11 comparable companies—3 public (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private entities in chips and semiconductors at same or adjacent stages, including Positron AI, Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, SambaNova Systems, and Etched.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $72M raised as a proxy for current value, implying $137M. The peer-median approach anchors to 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Rebellions at $2.3B Series A, d-Matrix at $2.0B Series A, Positron AI at $1.0B Series B, DEEPX at $529M Series C), yielding a median of $1.5B with a range of $529M to $2.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 20.4x across 3 tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of Lumotive's revenue disclosure.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $116M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $818M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around revenue traction and capital efficiency relative to the peer set. The stage-progression method implies conservatism relative to peer valuations, while peer-median reflects broader market comps. Key unknowns include Lumotive's revenue run rate and path to profitability relative to the heterogeneous peer cohort.
